title: Marras 2001: sex-specific regressions of maximum fibre-corrected CSA ("PCSA") on anthropometry

imaging.modality: MRI 1.5 T Philips GyroScan, T1 spin echo
imaging.plane: transverse slices perpendicular to the scan table through approximate vertebral body centres T8-S1; areas then fibre-angle corrected (dot product with literature fibre directions)

quantity.name: regression
quantity.definition: regression equation(s) predicting a muscle-geometry quantity from anthropometry

source.authors: Marras WS, Jorgensen MJ, Granata KP, Wiand B
source.sample: 30 healthy subjects (20 F, 10 M); young healthy volunteers (same 30 subjects/MRI scans as Jorgensen 2001)

how_to_simulate: Evaluate the regression equation with the subject anthropometry (units as given in data).
Compare the model quantity (as defined for the predicted variable) with the predicted value +/- SE of prediction.
protocol.notes: Predictor units per Table 4 (TDTWXPH uses height in m; the Jorgensen 2001 erratum does not concern this table). "Male vs Female" column = P of a sex indicator in hierarchical regression.

data.note: printed '23.84 + 6.6HTDWT'; the corresponding average and left equations have negative slopes (-6.73, -6.87), so '+' is probably a misprint for '-'; kept as printed
printed '0.418TDTWXPH' with no intercept (misprint or zero intercept)

extraction.check_notes: All rows verified on rendered pages 44-45 (rotated); male-column row assignment taken from the image.
